# Slogs progress report validation

- accepted: false
- policyVersion: 2026.10.30.1
- failureIds: progress.counts.missing, progress.display.mismatch, progress.evidence.state.invalid, progress.evidence.unconfirmed, progress.group.estimated, progress.group.reason.missing, progress.group.status.invalid
- validationScope: submitted structured report only; external evidence and later Agent prose are not authenticated
- recoveryRequired: true
- nextAction: Inspect authoritative source evidence, call llm_wiki_repair_progress_report with the failed report and refreshed evidence draft, revalidate, and emit only the passing canonical text. Never retry unchanged invalid evidence or shrink the scope.

reason: The bounded repair still returned progress.counts.missing; no passing canonical report was returned. Task execution counts remain recorded separately.
